description: Run the paired-block head stage of the bounded K-mismatch LZ repetition search.

source.title: Approximate Tandem Repeats
source.paper: Finding Approximate Repetitions under Hamming Distance
source.technical_report: INRIA RR-4163 (2001), section 3, first block-head stage and Algorithm 1
source.reuse: Algorithm definitions and ideas only; package implementation and fixtures are clean-room.

contract.terminal_precondition: The final symbol occurs nowhere earlier in the text.
contract.factorization: Copy-overlap Lempel-Ziv factors: each factor is the shortest prefix of the unparsed suffix with no earlier occurrence; the earlier occurrence may overlap the current factor.
contract.block_rule: Partition the factor sequence into consecutive blocks of at most K+2 factors. Process each ordered adjacent pair (B_i,B_(i+1)); an unpaired final block is omitted.
contract.context_rule: For a pair spanning [a,b), let s=b-a. Use context text[max(0,a-s):b], i.e. the pair preceded by the available suffix of length s.
contract.stage_rule: Run the report's Algorithm 1 in that context at the last character of B_i. Keep repetitions containing that character or either adjacent character, then discard repetitions touching the last character of B_(i+1). Union duplicate records across contexts.
contract.touch_rule: A repetition [start,end] touches position h iff start<=h+1 and end>=h-1.
contract.maximality: Algorithm 1 emits repetitions maximal within the selected context under one-character left/right extension and at most K mismatches between period-shifted symbols.
contract.output_scope: The paired block-head stage only; the later binary-division and within-factor stages are separate benchmark profiles.
contract.output_encoding: Little-endian signed-64 words [record_count,(start,length,period,mismatches)*record_count], sorted by start, length, period, then mismatches.
contract.validation_order: Validate the entire input frame before checking output nullness/capacity; errors write no bytes.

output.encoding: little-endian signed-64 count followed by four signed-64 fields per record

workspace.accounting: Fixed text/factor/context arrays, a 7,488-bit candidate set (936 bytes), reversed-context scratch, and bounded traversal locals fit below 8,192 bytes; caller buffers are excluded.

complexity.primary: O((K+1)n^3) for factorization and extension scans, plus O(n^4) serialization from per-record mismatch recounts; O(n^3) candidate bits and O(n) bounded scratch.
complexity.independent_reference: O(n^3) interval/period candidates per context, each with O(n) direct mismatch recounting, across up to O(n) contexts: O(n^5) worst-case time.
